pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregularly shaped, roughly polygonal dark regions with soft to moderate edge gradients. Patch density increases toward the ventral region, while patch size is maximized on the mid-flank.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Light-colored interstitial pathways forming a continuous topological graph. Junction nodes are primarily tri-radial. Continuity is maintained across the visible flank, with pixel thickness narrowing significantly in the posterior-ventral quadrant.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Low-amplitude, high-frequency serrations visible along the cranial-dorsal mane. The silhouette is jagged against the sky and background foliage.
dorsal_ridge_profile.contour_gaps: A prominent structural break in the mane line occurs at the shoulder junction, occupied by the dark silhouette of an avian organism.

focal_dorsal_anomalies.chronic_feeding_lesions: Large, localized region of severe textural disruption and hyper-pigmentation on the upper flank and dorsal ridge. The area appears rugose, thickened, and grayish-brown, completely obscuring the underlying pelage pattern.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive dermatological lesion on the upper dorsal flank, characterized by significant skin thickening and surface irregularity.
other_distinctive_markers: Presence of a dark-colored bird (oxpecker) perched directly on the dorsal ridge near the center of the visible torso.
